{
 "cases": [
  {
   "name": "不带 Authorization 头",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "missing",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 401,
   "expect_code": "missing_api_key"
  },
  {
   "name": "无效的 API Key",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "invalid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 401,
   "expect_code": "invalid_api_key"
  },
  {
   "name": "有效的 API Key，但无权访问模型",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "limited",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 403,
   "expect_code": "model_not_allowed"
  },
  {
   "name": "有效的 API Key，但模型不存在",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 404,
   "expect_code": "model_not_found"
  },
  {
   "name": "请求体不是合法 JSON",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": "{",
   "expect_status": 400,
   "expect_code": "invalid_json"
  },
  {
   "name": "缺少 model 字段",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 400,
   "expect_code": "invalid_parameter"
  },
  {
   "name": "max_tokens 超过上限",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 400,
   "expect_code": "invalid_parameter"
  },
  {
   "name": "模型类型和接口不匹配",
   "method": "POST",
   "path": "/v1/chat/completions",
   "auth": "valid",
   "body": null,
   "raw_body": null,
   "expect_status": 400,
   "expect_code": "model_kind_mismatch"
  }
 ]}
